business_summary: The Kodensha Co., Ltd. designs, constructs, and contracts electrical equipment projects and sells electrical and electronic equipment in Japan. It operates through the Electrical Equipment Construction Business and Product Sales Business segments. It engages in the design, construction, and contracting of indoor wiring, power transmission line construction, power generation and transformation, telecommunications, and air conditioning construction. It is also involved in the design and installation of electrical equipment and other equipment; proposals and equipment diagnostics; various energy-saving measures and renovations for aging equipment; power line construction work, including foundation work, tower assembly, and electrical wiring work; civil engineering works; surveying and research; complementary patrol; and maintenance work. In addition, it distributes electrical, information and communications, and refrigeration machinery and equipment; electronic machinery and instruments for control and measurement; and transformer equipment, and machine tools and equipment. Further, it sells FA control equipment and power distribution control equipment comprising sequencers, graphic operation terminals, general-purpose inverters, AC servos, no-fuse breakers, electronic energy meters, demand monitoring and control equipment, top runner transformers, geared motors, and motors; and cooling and heating equipment, such as packaged air conditioners for facilities, room air conditioners, ceiling-mounted ventilation fans, jet towels, commercial air conditioners, CO2 heat pump water heaters, standard ventilation fans, unit coolers, air-cooled heat pump chillers, and condensing units, as well as bus drying, heating, and ventilation systems. Additionally, it provides robots, vision sensor, and label printer system construction solutions. The company was founded in 1910 and is based in Chuo, Japan. The Kodensha Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Mitsubishi Electric Corporation.
business_summary_ko: Kodensha Co., Ltd.는 일본에서 전기 장비 프로젝트를 설계, 시공 및 계약하고 전기 및 전자 장비를 판매합니다. 전기 장비 건설 사업과 제품 판매 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 실내배선의 설계, 시공, 계약, 송전선로 건설, 발전 및 변전, 통신, 공조공사 등을 영위하고 있습니다. 또한 전기 장비 및 기타 장비의 설계 및 설치에도 관여합니다. 제안 및 장비 진단; 노후화된 장비에 대한 다양한 에너지 절약 조치 및 개조; 기초 공사, 탑 조립, 전기 배선 공사를 포함한 전력선 건설 공사; 토목공사; 측량 및 연구; 보완 순찰; 그리고 유지보수 작업. 또한 전기, 정보통신, 냉동 기계 및 장비를 유통합니다. 제어 및 측정용 전자 기계 및 기기; 변압기 장비, 공작 기계 및 장비. 또한 시퀀서, 그래픽오 등으로 구성된 FA 제어 장비와 배전 제어 장비도 판매하고 있다.
